title: Anthropic’s Annualized Revenue Surges to $65B Amid Rapid Growth and IPO Plans
summary: Anthropic's annualized revenue has reached $65 billion as of July 2026, marking a significant acceleration in growth from $47 billion in May and $9 billion at the end of 2025. Investors anticipate the company will finish 2026 with revenue between $100 billion and $120 billion. Anthropic's growth rate has outpaced rival OpenAI, which doubled its revenue to $40 billion in the same period. Both companies have filed confidential IPO paperwork, with Anthropic potentially going public as early as fall 2026, seeking a valuation of $2 trillion or more.
key_points: Anthropic's annualized revenue surged to $65 billion by the end of July 2026, up from $47 billion in May and $9 billion at the end of 2025.
Investors expect Anthropic to reach $100–120 billion in revenue by the end of 2026.
OpenAI's revenue doubled to $40 billion in the same period, but Anthropic's growth rate has attracted more investor interest.
Both Anthropic and OpenAI have filed confidential IPO paperwork, with Anthropic potentially going public in fall 2026.
Anthropic is seeking a public valuation of $2 trillion or more, which would make it the largest market debut on record.
